title: AED w Bydgoszczy
publisher_context: Map embedded in the official city website; original map ownership and reuse terms require confirmation.
notes: Only the AED folder is imported; the city outline and cultural park are not AED devices.
Address-only records are kept in staging; their absence of KML coordinates does not mean the city map cannot display them.
Geocoding a building address would locate the building, not necessarily the AED entrance or its position indoors.
No automatic union or deduplication with OSM records has been performed.
